Sculpting this trench trooper helmet and gas mask has been a real labor of love. I felt there was a gap in the available styles and wanted to create something with a fresh new look. This kit is designed to be used with Blender (free software) for digital kitbashing alongside other trench trooper-type kits.

The head is also provided on its own, without a neck, and with the tube in a basic position. The file includes an approximate body (not the one shown in the images) to give you a rough idea of how it might look as part of a full miniature.
